SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-22: CQL — Errors and Messaging. Test these items: Message(source, condition, code, severity, message). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Reference Appendix B, Errors and Messaging: Message(source T, condition Boolean, code String, severity String, message String) T.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe showed translate_cql accepted Message('src', true, 400, 'Warning', 'boom') and a code alias through as Any, allowing SQL/runtime casting even though code is declared String.
issues.root_cause: Message signature validation checked condition, severity, and message operands but omitted the code operand, allowing statically non-String code expressions to reach SQL helper casting.
issues.resolution: Extended _validate_message_signature_args to validate code with the same static String operand guard used for severity/message; added focused regression cases for integer and Boolean code operands.
issues.verified_in: .temp/qa/cql22_explorer_probe.py; pytest fhir4ds/cql/duckdb/tests/integration/test_message_parity.py -q (8 passed); pytest fhir4ds/cql/tests/official/test_cql_compliance.py -q -k CqlErrorsAndMessaging (4 passed); full conformance 2822/2822.
